subject: Request: allocate July charges, issue credit & VAT evidence
messages:
From: Julian Torres <julian@skylark.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@skylark.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Duplicate July charge across projects — need split & VAT evidence

Hi Aisha,

Heads up — our accounting team flagged two charges for July that look like the same Redwood usage billed to both Project-Alpha (acct SK-001) and Project-Beta (acct SK-002). Total is ~ $18,600; one of the lines appears duplicated due to a connector switchover on July 14. We need: 1) an apportionment of the duplicated amount between the two projects, 2) a credit applied to the account that was overbilled, and 3) an official VAT certificate/evidence for our finance team to book the credit.

I attached the July invoice extract and highlighted the duplicated line. Can you advise the timeline? Month-end close is next Monday and we need documentation to submit.

Thanks,
Julian Torres
Head of Infrastructure, Skylark AI
[Attachment: invoice_July_2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Torres <julian@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Duplicate July charge across projects — need split & VAT evidence

Julian — thanks for the clear note and the highlighted extract. I’m sorry for the disruption here. I’ve looped in Marissa (Billing Ops) and Ben (Account Lead) to confirm the allocation and run a credit.

Prelim plan:
- We’ll validate the connector switchover timestamp and confirm which account should retain the usage.
- We can issue a proportional goodwill credit to the overbilled account and reissue a corrected invoice.
- Marissa will request a VAT certificate from our tax team for your records — if you can send your VAT registration number or the cert it will speed things up.

Can you confirm the two account IDs in your system (SK-001 and SK-002) are the ones we should reference and attach the VAT file if available? I’ll aim to have a provisional credit memo to you within 24–48 hours.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | aisha_rahman@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Torres <julian@skylark.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T07:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Duplicate July charge across projects — need split & VAT evidence

Hi Julian — copying billing ops. We pulled the invoice and connector logs; there was indeed an overlap window on 2026-07-14 where the session IDs were routed to both accounts during a rotation. Proposed resolution:

- Total duplicated amount: $6,480.
- Allocation: $3,240 to SK-001 and $3,240 to SK-002 (we propose issuing a credit of $3,240 to SK-002 which shows as the net overcharge).
- We will generate a formal credit memo (CM-472) and a corrected invoice for SK-002.

Action items for you: please attach your VAT certificate or VAT number so we can include the proper tax treatment on the credit memo. If you prefer a refund instead of a credit, confirm payout details (bank or card) and we’ll route it via our refunds queue.

Attached: draft credit memo (provisional) for your review. We need your signoff to finalize.

Thanks — I’ll expedite once I have the VAT evidence.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_memo_SKY-472.pdf (pdf)]

From: Julian Torres <julian@skylark.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@skylark.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Duplicate July charge across projects — need split & VAT evidence

Marissa — thanks. Confirming SK-001 and SK-002 are correct. Attaching our VAT certificate and VAT reg number (SKYL-GB-99823). We prefer a credit memo applied to SK-002 rather than a refund. Please proceed with corrected invoice and the VAT-detailed credit memo — Finance needs the certificate appended for the month-end journal.

Also, can you add a short explanatory note on the credit memo that references the connector rotation and the duplicated session IDs? That helps our auditors.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Julian
[Attachment: vat_certificate_skylark.pdf (pdf)]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Torres <julian@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T10:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Duplicate July charge across projects — need split & VAT evidence

Julian — final confirmation:

- Credit issued: CM-472 for $3,240 applied to SK-002.
- Corrected invoice: INV-2026-07-SK-002 (reissued) with credit line and VAT breakdown attached.
- Notes: credit memo includes the connector rotation explanation and the duplicated session ID range per your request.
- Timeline: credit applied to the account today; your portal will reflect the corrected invoice immediately. If you need a cash refund later, we can convert the credit within 7 business days upon request.

I’ve attached a link to the credit record for your accounting team: https://app.redwood.ai/billing/credits/CR-9321. Let me know if you need the documents bundled differently for your month-end close.

Thanks for the quick responses — we’ll also flag the connector routing logic with infra to avoid recurrence.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://app.redwood.ai/billing/credits/CR-9321]
